name: Erotic Disciple
description: You dedicated yourself to the disciplined study and practice of erotic arts under a master or tradition.

traits: Intimacy is an art that is best expressed over long periods of time and with great attention to detail.
I treat my body as a sacred vessel, and do the same for my lovers.
I take great pride in being able to provide pleasure to my lovers.
I am patient in all things, especially sex, for the journey is as indulgent and gratifying as the destination.
I attempt to achieve higher states of awareness and enlightenment through pleasure.
I use my sexuality as a means of providing healing, physical and emotional.
I am obsessive about my craft and may spend hours perfecting a single technique on many different lovers.
I surround myself with erotic lore in hopes of finding ancient, forgotten techniques to bring higher states of pleasure to my lovers.

ideals.text: Enlightenment. I believe that pleasure can heal and enlighten those that partake with an uninhibited mind.
Self-Expression. We can most wholly express our innermost self through giving and receiving pleasure.
Healing. Love heals all wounds, whether it is sexual or not.
Patience. To rush through intimacy is to forego the most exquisite of experiences.
Pleasure. Pleasure is nothing to be ashamed of, no matter how you achieve it.
Hedonism. There is nothing more important than the pursuit of pleasure.

bonds: I am happy to teach others my craft, especially if they learn through experience.
I learned the benefits of healing through intimacy from a parental figure that I grew to love as a partner.
My life is a sexual and emotional journey that is a never-ending search for new experiences.
I feel responsible for the sexual journeys of others and eagerly seek to guide anyone on their own quest.
I seek not only personal exploration but social exploration through sexuality.
I long for a partner who yearns for a deeply erotic and personal journey like I do.
flaws: I have been known to neglect other aspects of my life in pursuit of sexual and erotic exploration.
I often feel guilty when I indulge too much in the pleasures of the flesh.
I am overly critical of my partners if I feel they are not as skillful as I am.
I sometimes forget the emotional and spiritual side of sexuality.
I see everything through a lens of sexuality that makes me feel perverse in the eyes of others.
My moral compass is the first sacrifice in my pursuit of novel carnal thrills.
